Content: MemorySmith includes a local fine-tune pipeline at /training-workbench (Admin-only). The system has three layers: (1) Data plane — ChatTranscriptWriter captures turn metadata and content to daily JSONL files with configurable redaction (Bearer tokens, api_key/secret patterns); SqliteChatFeedbackStore stores thumbs up/down ratings per turn. (2) Orchestration — TrainingHarnessRunnerService probes Python dependencies (torch, transformers, trl, peft), launches harness.py as a subprocess with timeout management, and reports live status. (3) Execution — harness.py supports simulated mode (no GPU), LoRA/QLoRA training with batched steps, cosine LR schedule, gradient checkpointing, and 4-bit quantization via BitsAndBytesConfig. Training data comes from chat transcripts or synthetic starter examples. The workbench UI shows dependency status, run history, settings proxy controls, and a start/dry-run launcher. All training config is under MemorySmith:Training with defaults that keep the harness in simulated mode until CUDA is available.
Title: Training Workbench and Fine-Tune Harness
